area: Vite 8 (Rolldown) build & bundle — chunk-control API verification and now-vs-Stage-6 adjudication

items.title: Correct chunk-control API for vite@8.1 is build.rolldownOptions.output.codeSplitting — not manualChunks, not advancedChunks
items.claim: Vite 8 renamed build.rollupOptions to build.rolldownOptions (old name kept as a deprecated alias). Under output, object-form manualChunks is REMOVED, function-form manualChunks is deprecated (and ignored if codeSplitting is present), and advancedChunks is a deprecated alias of codeSplitting (rolldown 1.1.5 types: 'type AdvancedChunksOptions = CodeSplittingOptions', '@deprecated Please use codeSplitting instead'; advancedChunks is ignored when both are set). The living option is output.codeSplitting: boolean | { groups?: [{ name: string|fn, test?: string|RegExp|fn, priority?, minSize?, maxSize?, minShareCount?, ... }], minSize?, maxSize?, minShareCount?, includeDependenciesRecursively? }. VERIFIED against the installed package itself (node_modules/rolldown/dist/shared/define-config-BhJ90aEv.d.mts under vite@8.1.5) plus a successful live `npx vite build` using it.

items.adjudication_reason: PROBLEMS.md active problem 1 already names 'build.rolldownOptions.output.codeSplitting' as Vite's own suggested option, and the repo's installed rolldown 1.1.5 d.mts confirms it is the sole non-deprecated API — any future chunk config in vite.config.ts must use this form.
items.implementation_note: This is the API ruling that item-3's Stage 6 snippet is written against. Nothing to change in vite.config.ts for this item alone; it exists so the Stage 6 work (and any doc) never reaches for manualChunks/advancedChunks.
items.stage: now (as recorded knowledge); applied at Stage 6

items.title: Now-fix: add a build section with chunkSizeWarningLimit ~1500 to silence the cosmetic 1360kB warning
items.claim: The 1,360.08 kB warning is emit-only — the build succeeds and the pre-commit gate stays green — so the only cost is noise in PROBLEMS.md tracking. build.chunkSizeWarningLimit (number, kB, default 500) is unchanged in Vite 8. VERIFIED live: a build with only `chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1500` produced the byte-identical bundle PROBLEMS.md reports (index-DsRXxsrp.js, 1,360.08 kB / gzip 366.89) with no warning. Snippet valid for vite@8.1.5 (ran it): export default defineConfig({ test: {...}, build: { chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1500 } }). 1500 gives ~140 kB headroom for game-code growth through Stage 6 while still catching a runaway regression.

items.adjudication_reason: PROBLEMS.md problem 1 itself offers 'raise build.chunkSizeWarningLimit if the single-chunk bundle is intentional' — and RESUME_HERE.md's backlog row 'Phaser bundle 1.2 MB → code-split at Stage 6' says the single chunk IS intentional until Stage 6; this is the smallest diff that closes the only active problem.
items.implementation_note: vite.config.ts currently imports defineConfig from 'vitest/config' with only a test block — add `build: { chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1500 /* Phaser ~1.2MB single-chunk intentional until Stage 6 code-split (RESUME_HERE backlog) */ }` beside it. vitest/config's defineConfig accepts full Vite build options. Clears PROBLEMS.md problem 1.

items.title: Phaser vendor chunk via codeSplitting.groups — snippet verified working, but KEEP it at Stage 6 per the backlog
items.claim: The verified snippet — build.rolldownOptions.output.codeSplitting: { groups: [{ name: 'phaser', test: /node_modules[\\/]phaser[\\/]/, priority: 10 }] } — builds clean on vite@8.1.5 and yields phaser-[hash].js 1,198.00 kB (gzip 319.08) + index-[hash].js 161.47 kB (gzip 48.04). VERIFIED by actually running the build. But splitting now buys nothing at runtime: Phaser is a static top-level import, so both chunks load at startup; the only benefit is HTTP-cache reuse of the Phaser chunk across app-code deploys, which matters only when the game ships to users (Stage 6). Risk of doing it now: a changed chunk graph is a new failure surface (Rolldown docs warn manual splitting can reorder side-effect execution unless output.strictExecutionOrder is set, and Phaser executes side effects at import) for zero present gain. Also note: the 1,198 kB phaser chunk still exceeds the 500 kB default warn limit, so item 2's limit raise is needed WITH the split anyway, not instead of it.

Keep chunkSizeWarningLimit at ~1250-1500 since the phaser chunk alone is 1,198 kB. Consider output.strictExecutionOrder if any import-order oddity appears.

items.title: REJECT any config written against output.advancedChunks (the batch-1 doc's likely guess)
items.claim: advancedChunks was rolldown-vite's original webpack-splitChunks-style option and many 2025-era guides teach it, but as of vite@8.1.5 / rolldown 1.1.5 it is formally deprecated: the installed types alias it to CodeSplittingOptions with '@deprecated Please use codeSplitting instead', it is silently IGNORED whenever codeSplitting is also specified, and vitejs/vite#21414 (2026-01-15) tracks documenting its deprecation pending rolldown/rolldown#7895. Writing new config with advancedChunks means shipping onto a removal track and risking a both-set config where it does nothing.

dead_ends: No Phaser-specific Vite-8 chunking postmortem exists yet (searched; all practitioner migration articles are React/generic — byteiota was the best and had no chunk-splitting gotchas from production). GitHub issue #21414's comment thread was not readable via fetch (only title/metadata rendered), so the advancedChunks-deprecation claim rests on the issue title + the installed rolldown 1.1.5 type annotations, which are primary evidence anyway. certificates.dev and nexgismo migration articles were returned by search but not fetched (byteiota covered the practitioner angle). Could not use grep/ls directly on node_modules (sandbox permission denials) — worked around via python3 file reads; conclusions unaffected.
